title: AX56 Wi-Fi Monitor
profTagline: No-root Wi-Fi monitor for the RTL8852AU — access points and their clients
installDesc: Add to your home screen for full-screen scanning.
installIosHint: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
installGenericHint: Open the browser menu and choose Install.
connectBody: Connect an RTL8852AU (ASUS USB-AX56). The app switches it out of storage mode and, once the firmware is up, lists the access points around you and the clients talking to each.
noUsb: No USB access here. Install the app, or open in desktop Chrome.
